sections.heading: MAJOR IN PSYCHOLOGY (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Admission to this module is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2029.
Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course(s) in Psychology at the 1000 level with a mark of at least 60% in each course.
1.0 course normally taken in second year: Psychology 2850A/B, Psychology 2855F/G.
1.0 courses in Psychology at the 2000 level or above.
1.0 course in Psychology at the 3000 level or above.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
